term: Mathematics of neural networks in machine learning
definition: An artificial neural network (ANN) or neural network combines biological principles with advanced statistics to solve problems in domains such as pattern recognition and game-play.
details: ANNs adopt the basic model of neuron analogues connected to each other in a variety of ways.
story: Picture an architect laying out a building where every room has to know which other rooms matter to it. The layout decides what the machine can even attempt, before it learns a single thing. It is the blueprint that makes everything else possible. It is the difference between a row of isolated cubicles and one big room where everyone can hear each other. That blueprint is Mathematics of neural networks in machine learning.
